AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

EnterpriseId.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise. Required when using [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property), ignored otherwise.

AccountId.description: Unique identifier of the account (`Customer` or `Company`) to which the payment method request is issued.

ExpirationUtc.description: Date and time of the payment method request's expiration in ISO 8601 format.

Description.description: Description of the payment method request displayed to the customer.

Email.description: Account email address for sending the payment method request. If not provided, uses the email from the customer profile.

EmailsToSend.description: Email notifications to send. If not specified, all emails will be sent. To disable all emails send an empty list. Additional email types may be added in the future.
